run_kmeans_subsampling: run k-means clustering on dataset features to find representative subsampled instances
run_store_kmeans_indexes: run the CLI tool to store k-means cluster indexes for imagenet or coco datasets
run_kmeans_with_gpu: run k-means training on normalized features using GPU acceleration via faiss
run_feature_subsampling: run feature extraction subsampling by finding closest instances to k-means centroids
run_kmeans_index_search: run a flat L2 index search to find nearest samples to k-means cluster centers
